name: facc-redux
title: Factorio Admin Command Center Redux
author: pharomwinters
description: Factorio 2.1 continuation of Factorio Admin Command Center by louanbastos. A powerful and intuitive GUI-based administration toolkit for Factorio. Includes over 20 categorized tools for editing, blueprinting, map cleanup, tech unlocks, pollution control, and more — all accessible via a sleek tabbed interface with Lua console support. Replaces the original mod in existing saves and keeps its saved state.
